name: 2015-16 Demographic Data - Admissions Methods
description:
This dataset lists New York City public schools for the 2015-16 school year along with the admissions methods they use. Each row identifies a school by its district borough number (DBN) and school name, and records one admissions method associated with that school. Because schools can use more than one method, the same school may appear in multiple rows, which is why there are 1,571 rows but only 1,567 distinct school names. Admissions methods are labeled by school level and type, such as "ES: Choice District" for elementary district choice or "MS: Screened" for screened middle school admissions, with 109 distinct method labels in total. The data is nearly complete, with no missing DBNs or admissions methods and only a handful of missing school names.

The dataset can be used to examine how admissions methods are distributed across schools and districts, compare selective and non-selective admissions approaches, and study patterns of school choice. It could support reporting or research on enrollment
